title: Syncthing
comment: Syncthing's --home directory (config.xml, keys, index database) carries as one tree; the Daemonless image runs it with --home=/config. The upstream syncthing/syncthing image keeps it under /var/syncthing/config and is not matched by this recipe. Shared folder paths inside config.xml still name the source's paths; bind the same datasets at those targets or re-point the folders after the first start. Proven 2026-09-29 on a stock FreeCORE-15.1-RC5 (222345a88d) appliance: a 14.4-RELEASE iocage jail running syncthing 2.1.2_4 converted to the Daemonless image (v2.1.5) in one apply; the device identity carried (identical device ID before and after), the GUI answered on the published port, and the jail's live port set (8384, 21027/udp, 22000 tcp+udp) was detected and mapped. The source jail was not modified.
